title: You Own Nvidia (Even If You Never Bought It) #shorts
description:
Got a 401(k) in an S&P 500 index fund? Out of every $100, about $6 is Nvidia, and $37 sits in just the 10 biggest holdings. Nvidia fell 37.6% from its Oct 6 close ($239.24) to Nov 25 ($149.30). The whole S&P 500 is down about 8% over the same days.
Full video on the Coin Theory channel.

Data: SPY holdings file from State Street Global Advisors (as of Nov 24, 2026, https://www.ssga.com/us/en/intermediary/library-content/products/fund-data/etfs/us/holdings-daily-us-en-spy.xlsx); daily closes for NVDA and the S&P 500 from Yahoo Finance.

This video is for education only and is not financial advice.
Original script and animation. Narrated with an AI voice.
